facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Mentorship, investor access, education, events and in-kind services; no program investment
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Canadian citizens or founders with businesses already incorporated in Canada; no Startup Visa support.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Growth-stage founder; ability to participate in required programming. No explicit investment/revenue threshold.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 Canada 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.Duration: One cohort per year; roughly 6 months with flexible à-la-carte participation
facts_raw.International Founder: 可能接受国际 founder；需确认签证/现场要求
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: 2026 deadline Mar 5; next application cycle TBD
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Seed / growth 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 只有想法、无 MVP/traction 的极早期项目

facts.Funding / Support: Mentorship, investor access, education, events and in-kind services; no program investment
facts.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Canadian citizens or founders with businesses already incorporated in Canada; no Startup Visa support.
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Growth-stage founder; ability to participate in required programming. No explicit investment/revenue threshold.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No standard attendance requirement published. Confirm the current cohort arrangements for Canada.
facts.Duration: One cohort per year; roughly 6 months with flexible à-la-carte participation
facts.International Founder: International founders may be eligible; confirm visa and attendance requirements.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: 2026 deadline Mar 5; next application cycle TBD
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Seed / growth stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Idea-only projects without an MVP or traction
